text:
anna: FYI - nightly billing run bill-2026-07-02 produced two invoices for 'AtlasBio' (cust_992). inv_240001A = $21,600, inv_240001B = $19,440. Second invoice missing 'Partner SLA 10%'. Job: run-10021. @billing-team

acct-bot: automated-retry created inv_240001B after initial PDF timeout.

josh: quick DB check: ```SELECT id, amount_cents, line_items FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_992' AND created_at > '2026-07-02';```
Result:
- inv_240001A | 2160000 | [{usage:1950000, sla:195000, tax:20000}]
- inv_240001B | 1944000 | [{usage:1944000}]

ram: logs show billing-worker encountered "PDFWriteTimeout" then retried. The retry path creates a fresh invoice row and skips attach_sla() because the job_run guard treats the retry as a different run and then short-circuits. File: billing/worker/attach_sla.py:52

anna: any captures? need to know refund/credit implications.

acct-bot: payment status: both uncaptured. No refunds.

josh: proposed immediate steps: 1) pause exporter for run-10021; 2) void inv_240001B with note 'duplicate from retry: missing SLA line SPT-1905'; 3) reissue corrected invoice inv_240001C. Need accounting approval to void.

ram: I'll open a small hotfix: make attach_sla idempotent (upsert by invoice_id + code) and add unique constraint invoice_lines(invoice_id, code). Also change retry to reuse invoice row when possible. PR will include unit test for retry path.

anna: I approve the void (no capture). Josh, please hold customer replies and add ticket link in void note. Draft to customer: "Hi AtlasBio - we discovered an automation issue where a retry created a duplicate invoice missing a partner SLA line. We'll void the duplicate and reissue the correct invoice today. No action needed on your side."

josh: will run void update after 10m: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='duplicate from retry: missing SLA line; see SPT-1905' WHERE id='inv_240001B';```

engops: paused exporter for run-10021 and created ENG-BILL-1018. Scheduling staging deploy of fix in 35m.

anna: thanks - tagging for month-end audit and reconciliation. :thumbsup:
